title: Quiet Residential Family Hideaway, Big Backyard
description:
Quiet two-bedroom, two-bath Nashville home for four guests, with one king bed and two single beds. Enjoy a full kitchen, gas fireplace, TV, sound system, in-unit washer and dryer, private backyard with outdoor seating, and driveway parking. Convenient to the Grand Ole Opry, Nashville International Airport, Nissan Stadium, and downtown.

The space
Welcome to this quiet two-bedroom, two-bath Nashville home, designed for up to four guests.

Sleeping layout:
• Bedroom 1: one king bed
• Bedroom 2: two single beds, including a twin rollaway

The living room includes comfortable seating, a gas fireplace, TV, and sound system. The roomy kitchen has granite workspaces, full-size appliances, cookware, a dishwasher, microwave, oven, stove, refrigerator, and coffee maker. The bright dining area seats four.

The primary bedroom has an en-suite bathroom with a tub/shower combination. The guest bathroom also includes a tub/shower combination. An in-unit washer and dryer are located just off the kitchen.

Outside, guests can enjoy the private backyard and outdoor seating. The driveway provides free on-site parking.

The home is convenient to the Grand Ole Opry, Nashville International Airport, Nissan Stadium, downtown Nashville, parks, dining, and live music.

Local permit: 032947, issued 2017.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
